description_en: Adds an IPv6 translation mapping entry to a specified IPv6 Translation Service instance
description_zh: 为指定的IPv6转换服务实例添加IPv6转换映射条目
kebab_example: aliyun vpc create-ipv6-translator-entry --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipv6-translator-id ipv6trans-bp1858ys57xxxxxx --allocate-ipv6-port 80 --backend-ipv4-addr 46.22.xx.xx --backend-ipv4-port 80 --trans-protocol tcp --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateIPv6TranslatorEntry

parameters.help_en: The region of the IPv6 Translation Service instance. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh: IPv6转换服务实例的地域。 您可以通过调用DescribeRegions接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the IPv6 Translation Service
parameters.name: ipv6_translator_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the IPv6 translation mapping entry. The name must be 2 to 100 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: IPv6转换映射条目的名称。长度为 2~100个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字，半角句点（.），下划线（_）和短划线（-）。但不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
parameters.name: entry_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the IPv6 translation mapping entry
parameters.name: entry_description

parameters.help_en: The port used by the IPv6 address allocated by the IPv6 Translation Service instance
parameters.help_zh: IPv6转换服务实例分配的IPv6地址的使用端口。
parameters.name: allocate_ipv6_port

parameters.help_en: The public IPv4 address that requires IPv6 services (the IPv4 address of the IPv4-only server)
parameters.help_zh: 需要提供IPv6服务的公网IPv4地址（IPv4-only的服务器的IPv4地址）。
parameters.name: backend_ipv4_addr

parameters.help_en: The port of the public IPv4 address that requires IPv6 services
parameters.help_zh: 需要提供IPv6服务的公网IPv4地址的端口
parameters.name: backend_ipv4_port

parameters.help_en:
The protocol type. Valid values:

tcp: Forwards TCP packets.  
udp: Forwards UDP packets
parameters.help_zh:
协议类型。取值：

tcp：转发TCP协议的报文。  
udp：转发UDP协议的报文。
parameters.name: trans_protocol

parameters.help_en:
The peak bandwidth of the IPv6 translation mapping entry. Valid values: 
        
-1 (default): No bandwidth limit is imposed on the IPv6 translation mapping entry.  
1-200Mbps: The bandwidth value of the mapping entry.            

The sum of peak bandwidth values of all IPv6 translation mapping entries cannot exceed the peak bandwidth of the instance
parameters.help_zh:
IPv6转换映射条目的带宽峰值。取值： 
        
-1（默认值）：不限制IPv6转换映射条目的带宽峰值。  
1-200Mbps：该映射条目的带宽值。            

所有IPv6转换映射条目的带宽峰值之和不能超过实例的带宽峰值
parameters.name: entry_bandwidth

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable access control. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启访问控制。取值：
on：是。
off：否
parameters.name: acl_status

parameters.help_en:
The type of access control:

white: Allows the IPv6 addresses in the access control policy group to access backend services.

black: Denies the IPv6 addresses in the access control policy group from accessing backend services
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启访问控制：

white：允许访问策略组中的IPv6地址访问后端服务。

black：禁止访问策略组中的IPv6地址访问后端服务
parameters.name: acl_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the associated access control policy group
parameters.help_zh: 关联的访问控制策略组ID
parameters.name: acl_id

Ipv6TranslatorEntryId.description_en: The instance ID of the IPv6 Translation Service
